{{Quote|You'll ''never'' believe this, Luke&hellip; but I've ''no idea'' how she got here&mdash;!|[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], upon discovering [[Mira Volz]] aboard the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] on Randa|<ref name="TSKR" />}}
'''Randa''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] which hosted a small [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Randa Rebel base|base]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. That led it to be targeted by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gaen Drommel]], who decimated the Rebels on Randa during the war.

==Description==
Located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim's]] [[Kessel sector/Legends|Kessel sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> Randa sat along the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] known as the [[Pabol Sleheyron/Legends|''Pabol Sleheyron'']].<ref name="TEA" />

==History==
By [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], Randa had become home to a small [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Randa Rebel base|base]], which briefly served as a place of refuge for [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] hero [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]. There he was visited by friends [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]]. who stopped by while on a [[Spice/Legends|spice]] run to [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]]. But during the ''[[Millennium Falcon/Legends|Millennium Falcon]]''{{'s}} visit to Randa, they realized that a young woman named [[Mira Volz]] had stowed away on the [[Starship/Legends|ship]]. Volz was a fugitive from the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]], which had attempted to use her as a hostage to force her father, [[Renn Volz]], to decimate Rebel-held [[Planet/Legends|planets]] with his ''[[Ionic Ring Ship]]''. Volz convinced them to help her, and together they managed to stop the Empire's plans at [[Little Kessel]].<ref name="TSKR" />

Randa's Rebel base eventually earned it the attention of the Empire, who sent [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gaen Drommel]] to decimate the planet. His successful operation on Randa earned Drommel a sizable reward, in the form of the command of the [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|''Executor''-class Star Dreadnought]] [[Guardian (Executor-class)|''Guardian'']].<ref name="Despoilers3">{{SW|url=news/the-imperial-warlords-despoilers-of-an-empire-part-3|series=The Imperial Warlords: Despoilers of an Empire|text=Part 3|nolive=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Randa first appeared in ''[[The Second Kessel Run]]'', a [[Star Wars (comic strip)|comic strip]] adaptation written by [[Russ Helm]] and released in [[1980]]. In the comic, it was illustrated by [[Russ Manning]].<ref name="TSKR" />
